dialogues.en: "I'm home...... Oh, are you going somewhere?"
dialogues.text: "I'm home...... Oh, are you going somewhere?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お帰りなさい……」
dialogues.en: "Hi, Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "Hi, Junichi-san......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、その、せっかく外に出られるようになっ
　たので、買い物に行こうかと……」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, since I can go outside by myself now, I was going to
go grocery shopping......"
dialogues.text:
"Yes, since I can go outside by myself now, I was going to
go grocery shopping......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、一緒に行くよ。ちょっと待ってて」
dialogues.en: "I'll go with you. Give me just a minute."
dialogues.text: "I'll go with you. Give me just a minute."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
部屋まで駆け上がり、床に鞄を放り投げ、今度
は玄関まで駆け下りる。
dialogues.en:
I run up to my room, throw my school bag on the floor, and
run down back to the front door.
dialogues.text:
I run up to my room, throw my school bag on the floor, and
run down back to the front door.

dialogues.jp: 「お待たせ。じゃ、行こうか」
dialogues.en: "Thank you for waiting. Let's go."
dialogues.text: "Thank you for waiting. Let's go."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「こうやって、一緒にお買い物をするのは、初
　めてですね……」
dialogues.en:
"It's our first time going grocery shopping together like
this......"
dialogues.text:
"It's our first time going grocery shopping together like
this......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……何か、新婚さんみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "......It feels like we're newlyweds."
dialogues.text: "......It feels like we're newlyweds."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですか……？」
dialogues.en: "R-Really......?"
dialogues.text: "R-Really......?"

dialogues.jp: 握り合った手に、少し力が込められる。
dialogues.en: She slightly tightens her grip on my hand.
dialogues.text: She slightly tightens her grip on my hand.

dialogues.jp:
肘の辺りにカゴをさげた頼子さんは、確かに若
奥様といった感じだ。
dialogues.en: Carrying a bag in her arm, she does look like a young wife.
dialogues.text: Carrying a bag in her arm, she does look like a young wife.

dialogues.jp: ……長ネギは買いたくないな。なんとなく。
dialogues.en: ...I don't want to buy a long onion today for some reason...
dialogues.text: ...I don't want to buy a long onion today for some reason...

dialogues.jp:
「でも、そうだな……。前に来た時は、買い物
　はしなかったし」
dialogues.en:
"But you're right...... When we went outside last time, we
didn't go shopping."
dialogues.text:
"But you're right...... When we went outside last time, we
didn't go shopping."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「カレーの材料を買った後で、少し歩こうか？」
dialogues.en:
"Do you want to go for a little walk after we get everything
we need for curry?"
dialogues.text:
"Do you want to go for a little walk after we get everything
we need for curry?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 「くお、重い……」
dialogues.en: "This is heavy......"
dialogues.text: "This is heavy......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「や、やっぱり、私も持ちますよ……」
dialogues.en: "I really don't mind carrying it......"
dialogues.text: "I really don't mind carrying it......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いいんだ」
dialogues.en: "No, I can do it."
dialogues.text: "No, I can do it."

dialogues.jp:
男の意地とばかりに首を振る。カゴに入りきら
なかった分はスーパーのビニール袋に入れたが
それは熟し切ったスイカのようになっていた。
dialogues.en:
I shake my head with my pride as a man. The bag she brought
is full of groceries and we got another plastic bag for the
rest that didn't fit in her bag, and it's as heavy as a big
watermelon.
dialogues.text:
I shake my head with my pride as a man. The bag she brought
is full of groceries and we got another plastic bag for the
rest that didn't fit in her bag, and it's as heavy as a big
watermelon.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ほんとに……大丈夫ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you...... sure you're all right?"
dialogues.text: "Are you...... sure you're all right?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ほんとにほんと。けど、重さはともかくとし
　て、ちょっと買いすぎたかも」
dialogues.en:
"I'm fine, really. I don't mind the weight, but we probably
bought a little too much."
dialogues.text:
"I'm fine, really. I don't mind the weight, but we probably
bought a little too much."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「たくさん食べて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "You can eat as much as you want."
dialogues.text: "You can eat as much as you want."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「たくさんの次元を越えている気もするが……。
　ま、深くは考えまい」
dialogues.en:
"I think we got more than we can eat as much as we
want......"
dialogues.text:
"I think we got more than we can eat as much as we
want......"

dialogues.jp:
あるいは、それはそれでいいのかもしれない。
たくさん食べれば、それだけ思い出すのも簡単
だろうから。
dialogues.en:
But maybe it's okay. The more I eat, the easier it'll be for
me to remember it.
dialogues.text:
But maybe it's okay. The more I eat, the easier it'll be for
me to remember it.

dialogues.jp:
頼子という女性が、どんな味のカレーを作って
くれたのかを……。
dialogues.en:
I can remember the taste of the curry that a woman called
Yoriko cooked for me.
dialogues.text:
I can remember the taste of the curry that a woman called
Yoriko cooked for me.

dialogues.jp: 「そんじゃ、適当に歩こうか」
dialogues.en: "Let's go for a walk."
dialogues.text: "Let's go for a walk."

dialogues.jp:
がっしゃがっしゃと、重たい足を踏み出す。頼
子さんの腕が、すっと腕に絡んできた。
dialogues.en:
I start to move my heavy feet one by one. Yoriko-san slowly
puts her arm through mine.
dialogues.text:
I start to move my heavy feet one by one. Yoriko-san slowly
puts her arm through mine.

dialogues.jp: 手を繋ごうにも、両手は｛ふさ／塞｝がっているのだ。
dialogues.en:
She wanted to hold my hands instead, but my hands were
occupied with bags.
dialogues.text:
She wanted to hold my hands instead, but my hands were
occupied with bags.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "What's the matter?"
dialogues.text: "What's the matter?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……あのお店は、何ですか……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, that store...... What is that store......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, that store...... What is that store......?"

dialogues.jp: 顔を向けた先に目を遣る。
dialogues.en: I look in the direction she's looking.
dialogues.text: I look in the direction she's looking.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、あれはゲーセンだ。ゲームセンター」
dialogues.en: "Oh, that's a game center. It's called GameCen."
dialogues.text: "Oh, that's a game center. It's called GameCen."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あれが……。あ、あの子達は何をやっている
　んです？」
dialogues.en: "What are they doing?"
dialogues.text: "What are they doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、クレーンゲームでしょ」
dialogues.en: "They are playing a game called UFO catcher."
dialogues.text: "They are playing a game called UFO catcher."

dialogues.jp:
子供が何人か固まって、クレーンゲームの筐体
に張りついていた。
dialogues.en: There are a few kids clustered around the machine.
dialogues.text: There are a few kids clustered around the machine.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……面白いんでしょうか？　何だか、熱中し
　ているみたいですけど……」
dialogues.en: "......Is it fun? They look like they're so into it......"
dialogues.text: "......Is it fun? They look like they're so into it......"

dialogues.jp: 少し迷った末、頼子さんは頷いた。
dialogues.en: "Do you want to try?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want to try?"

dialogues.en: After thinking about it for a while, she nods.
dialogues.text: After thinking about it for a while, she nods.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ぜ、全然取れません……」
dialogues.en: "I can't catch anything......"
dialogues.text: "I can't catch anything......"

dialogues.jp:
チャレンジする事１０数回。頼子さんは遂に音
を上げた。
dialogues.en: She tried 10 times. She finally gave up.
dialogues.text: She tried 10 times. She finally gave up.

dialogues.jp:
自分達はやらないからと、脇に退いてくれた子
ども達も、ツチノコでも見つけたように口をあ
んぐり開けている。
dialogues.en:
The kids who stood aside to watch her play are lost for
words in shock, with their mouths open as if they just found
a mysterious creature.
dialogues.text:
The kids who stood aside to watch her play are lost for
words in shock, with their mouths open as if they just found
a mysterious creature.

dialogues.jp: 「どうする？　もう止める？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want to do now? Do you want to give up?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to do now? Do you want to give up?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いえ、もう１度だけ……」
dialogues.en: "No, one last time......"
dialogues.text: "No, one last time......"

dialogues.jp:
闘志みなぎる瞳に、俺は財布からコインを取り
だした。
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.en:
Her eyes are full of fighting spirit. I take a coin from my
wallet.
dialogues.text:
Her eyes are full of fighting spirit. I take a coin from my
wallet.

dialogues.jp: 駄目でした。
dialogues.en: She didn't get it.
dialogues.text: She didn't get it.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「ああっ！　もう、見てらんないよっ！」
dialogues.en: "Oh, you suck! I can't watch this anymore!"
dialogues.text: "Oh, you suck! I can't watch this anymore!"

dialogues.jp:
何故か観客を決め込んでいた子ども達の、その
一人が、じたばたと暴れ出した。
dialogues.en: One of the kids starts to act up.
dialogues.text: One of the kids starts to act up.

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、それ以前から、ガヤガヤワイワイ
騒々しかったけれど。
dialogues.en:
Actually, they already have been very noisy since and even
before we started to play.
dialogues.text:
Actually, they already have been very noisy since and even
before we started to play.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「オレがお手本見せちゃる！」
dialogues.en: "I'll show you how it should be done!"
dialogues.text: "I'll show you how it should be done!"

dialogues.jp: ポケットをごそごそやり、コインを投入する。
dialogues.en: He rummages through his pockets and takes a coin out.
dialogues.text: He rummages through his pockets and takes a coin out.

dialogues.jp: 「おお」
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.jp:
いかにも、慣れた手さばき。頼子さんも、息を
呑んだ様子で見守っている。
dialogues.en:
His play was marvelously smooth and elegant. Yoriko-san's
also watching him play it without breathing.
dialogues.text:
His play was marvelously smooth and elegant. Yoriko-san's
also watching him play it without breathing.

dialogues.jp: そして……。

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、取れた」
dialogues.en: "See? I got it."
dialogues.text: "See? I got it."

dialogues.jp:
手には、クレーンゲームではおなじみのぬい
ぐるみが、ちょこなんと乗っかっている。
dialogues.en:
He holds up a soft toy he caught with the UFO catcher
machine.
dialogues.text:
He holds up a soft toy he caught with the UFO catcher
machine.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp:
「もっかいやってみなよ、おねーちゃん。オレ
　が教えてやっからさ」
dialogues.en: "You should try one more time. I'll teach you."
dialogues.text: "You should try one more time. I'll teach you."

dialogues.jp:
つるんと手の甲を鼻に擦りつけると、得意げに
そう言った。
dialogues.en: He says proudly, rubbing the palm of his hand to his nose.
dialogues.text: He says proudly, rubbing the palm of his hand to his nose.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「や、やった、やりましたっ」
dialogues.en: "Yes! I got it!"
dialogues.text: "Yes! I got it!"

dialogues.jp: ぬいぐるみを手に、小さく跳ねる。
dialogues.en: She jumps up and down with a soft toy in her hand.
dialogues.text: She jumps up and down with a soft toy in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「やりましたよ、朝倉さん……」
dialogues.en: "I did it, Junichi-san......"
dialogues.text: "I did it, Junichi-san......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「や、そんな、涙ぐまんでも……」
dialogues.en: "Your eyes are getting watery......"
dialogues.text: "Your eyes are getting watery......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「な、何だか嬉しくて……」
dialogues.en: "I'm just so happy......"
dialogues.text: "I'm just so happy......"

dialogues.jp: くすくすと笑いながら、目尻を拭う。
dialogues.en: She rubs the corner of her eyes as she smiles and chuckles.
dialogues.text: She rubs the corner of her eyes as she smiles and chuckles.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「自分にも、頑張れば出来るんだなって……」
dialogues.en: "I can do it if I try hard......"
dialogues.text: "I can do it if I try hard......"

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp:
「おっと、オレのおかげってのを忘れないでく
　れよな」
dialogues.en: "And don't forget that I helped you, too."
dialogues.text: "And don't forget that I helped you, too."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「うん、ありがとうね、ぼく」
dialogues.en: "Yes, thank you so much, young man."
dialogues.text: "Yes, thank you so much, young man."

dialogues.jp:
しゃがみこみ、視線を合わせる。照れたような
赤い顔で、子どもは目を逸らした。
dialogues.en:
She crouches down to the level of the boy. The boy gets shy
and his face turns red a little.
dialogues.text:
She crouches down to the level of the boy. The boy gets shy
and his face turns red a little.

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「ま、まあ、分かってりゃいいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "I just wanted to make sure you remember I helped you."
dialogues.text: "I just wanted to make sure you remember I helped you."

dialogues.speaker: Kid
dialogues.jp: 「おい、みんな、もう行こうぜっ。バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "H-Hey guys, let's go! Bye-bye!"
dialogues.text: "H-Hey guys, let's go! Bye-bye!"

dialogues.jp:
手を振り、こちらが何も言わない内に走り去っ
てしまった。残された子ども達が、一瞬遅れて
後を追う。
dialogues.en:
He waves at us and runs off before we can say anything. The
rest of the kids follow him.
dialogues.text:
He waves at us and runs off before we can say anything. The
rest of the kids follow him.

dialogues.jp: 「やれやれ、やっと静かになったか」
dialogues.en: "Whew, now it's finally quiet."
dialogues.text: "Whew, now it's finally quiet."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私が取ったんですよね、これ……。ほんとに
　嬉しいです。ずっと、大切にします……」
dialogues.en:
"I did get this on my own...... I'm so happy. I'll keep it
as my treasure forever......"
dialogues.text:
"I did get this on my own...... I'm so happy. I'll keep it
as my treasure forever......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （ずっと……か）
dialogues.en: (Forever......)
dialogues.text: (Forever......)

dialogues.jp: クレーンゲームの前に立つ。
dialogues.en: "......Okay. I'm gonna try as well. Just one time."
dialogues.text: "......Okay. I'm gonna try as well. Just one time."

dialogues.jp: 「実は俺も、割と得意だったりして」
dialogues.en: I stand up in front of the UFO catcher machine.
dialogues.text: I stand up in front of the UFO catcher machine.

dialogues.jp:
コインを投入し、レバーを握る。久しぶりの感
触に、身体がたぎった。
dialogues.en: "I'm actually good at this."
dialogues.text: "I'm actually good at this."

dialogues.en:
I put a coin in the machine and grab the lever. I get
excited at the touch of the lever that I haven't touched for
a long time.
dialogues.text:
I put a coin in the machine and grab the lever. I get
excited at the touch of the lever that I haven't touched for
a long time.

dialogues.jp: 「はい。一丁あがりっと」
dialogues.en: "See? There you go."
dialogues.text: "See? There you go."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「わあ……上手いですね……」
dialogues.en: "Wow...... You are good......"
dialogues.text: "Wow...... You are good......"

dialogues.jp: 手の平に置かれた小箱を見つめる。
dialogues.en: She looks at the little box I got on my hand.
dialogues.text: She looks at the little box I got on my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……そんなに上手いなら、教えてくれれば良
　かったのに……」
dialogues.en: "You should have taught me earlier if you're that good."
dialogues.text: "You should have taught me earlier if you're that good."

dialogues.jp: 上目遣いに、不満を漏らした。
dialogues.en: She looks up at me and complains.
dialogues.text: She looks up at me and complains.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、ガキどもの手前、何だか恥ずかしくて」
dialogues.en: "I just got a little shy with those kids, you know."
dialogues.text: "I just got a little shy with those kids, you know."

dialogues.jp: 「ま、それはともかく……何だろな、これ……」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what do you think this is......?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what do you think this is......?"

dialogues.jp:
適当に選んだのだが、果たして中身は何だろう。
がさがさと包装を破り、中の｛ふた／蓋｝を開ける。
dialogues.en:
I caught it without knowing what it is. I tear the paper and
open the box.
dialogues.text:
I caught it without knowing what it is. I tear the paper and
open the box.

dialogues.jp: 驚きの声の後、顔を見合わせる二人。
dialogues.en: We look at each other in surprise.
dialogues.text: We look at each other in surprise.

dialogues.jp: 中に入っていたのは、おもちゃの指輪だった。
dialogues.en:
It's a toy ring inside the box. It's a little ring which
would probably only fit on her pinky finger.
dialogues.text:
It's a toy ring inside the box. It's a little ring which
would probably only fit on her pinky finger.

dialogues.jp:
そのせいなのか、それは少し小さいようだった。
たぶん、小指に入るくらいのサイズ。
dialogues.en: But no matter how small and how plastic it is, it's a ring.
dialogues.text: But no matter how small and how plastic it is, it's a ring.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、おもちゃとは言え、小さいとは言え、
それは指輪だ。
dialogues.en: "Y-Yoriko-san......"
dialogues.text: "Y-Yoriko-san......"

dialogues.jp:
お互いに緊張した声を出して、またも見つめ合
う。
dialogues.en: We look at each other again nervously.
dialogues.text: We look at each other again nervously.

dialogues.jp: 「手……出して、くれる？」
dialogues.en: "Can you show me your hand?"
dialogues.text: "Can you show me your hand?"

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんののどが、小さく上下する。
dialogues.en: I can see her holding her breath.
dialogues.text: I can see her holding her breath.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「う、受け取れません……」
dialogues.en: "I-I can't accept it......"
dialogues.text: "I-I can't accept it......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
指先につまんだ指輪を取り落としそうになり、
俺は慌てて力を入れた。
dialogues.en:
I nearly drop the ring from my fingers, so I quickly hold it
tighter.
dialogues.text:
I nearly drop the ring from my fingers, so I quickly hold it
tighter.

dialogues.jp: 差し出した手の、所在が失われる。
dialogues.en: I don't know what to do with my hand holding the ring.
dialogues.text: I don't know what to do with my hand holding the ring.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「だ、だって、私は……」
dialogues.en: "B-Because I......"
dialogues.text: "B-Because I......"

dialogues.jp:
急に、雑踏のざわめきが、耳の中で耐え難いま
でに膨れ上がった。
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden the noise of the crowds starts to swell so
loud in my ears that I can barely stand.
dialogues.text:
All of a sudden the noise of the crowds starts to swell so
loud in my ears that I can barely stand.

dialogues.jp:
拒絶されたことよりも、その後に続く言葉の方
が辛い。
dialogues.en:
It isn't her rejection that hurts the most. It's what she's
about to say.
dialogues.text:
It isn't her rejection that hurts the most. It's what she's
about to say.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「も、もう帰りましょう。食材が傷んでしまい
　ます……」
dialogues.en: "We... We should go home now. The food will get bad......"
dialogues.text: "We... We should go home now. The food will get bad......"

dialogues.jp:
俺の返事を待たずに、商店街を向こうへと歩い
ていく。
dialogues.en: Without waiting for my reply, she starts to walk.
dialogues.text: Without waiting for my reply, she starts to walk.

dialogues.jp:
俺は指輪をポケットに押し込むと、その後を追っ
ていったのだった。
dialogues.en: I put the ring into my pocket and follow her.
dialogues.text: I put the ring into my pocket and follow her.

dialogues.jp: ◆指輪◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんと一緒に買い物に出かけた。二人で手
を繋いで商店街を歩いた。
dialogues.en: Time has passed by fast.
dialogues.text: Time has passed by fast.

dialogues.jp:
途中寄ったゲームセンター、何の気なしに俺が
取ったクレーンゲームの景品はおもちゃの指輪
だった。
dialogues.en:
When you sleep in almost all your classes, the time really
flies so fast.
dialogues.text:
When you sleep in almost all your classes, the time really
flies so fast.

dialogues.jp:
指輪を頼子さんに渡そうとしたが、頼子さんは
それを受け取ろうとはしなかった。
dialogues.en: "It's time to go home......"
dialogues.text: "It's time to go home......"

dialogues.jp:
拒絶されたことよりも、頼子さんの言いかけた
言葉の方が辛かった。
dialogues.en:
My voice disappears into the empty room. I feel cold air
touching my back as I leave the room.
dialogues.text:
My voice disappears into the empty room. I feel cold air
touching my back as I leave the room.
